beats.text: I pitched the game around. In December 2019, Gigamic, the publisher of Quarto and Squadro, turned it down. The strategy part seemed a bit too light for them.
I tried to ask what they meant by that, or which winning strategies they found, but never heard back.
In the end I published it with a small Czech publisher Maty Moves in 2020.
The reception was lukewarm, to put it kindly. And one comment kept coming back, in different words: the first player has an advantage you cannot beat.
First player advantage seems to take the legs out from underneath this design.
Going first gave me a near-unbeatable advantage. Maybe if player one doesn't take the center space... but why wouldn't you? Still, no fun to feel like a bully.

To be clear, this video is not here to prove anyone wrong. The game did not land well with players, and that's OK. I have no right to tell players how they are supposed to have fun playing board games.
